text: When a CLI tool wraps a git commit, extract identity args into a pure `build_commit_args()`-style helper so unit tests can assert the inline `-c user.name/user.email` flags without running git; the integration test then runs the full CLI against a stripped-identity env to close the gap.

When a prompt-assembly.js enrichment reads data from disk, the I/O helper belongs in orchestrator.js (fail-soft, try/catch per item) while the pure renderer in prompt-assembly.js stays fs-free and accepts the data as a caller-supplied map — see agentSkillDescriptions + skillsSection pattern in PR #618.

For AC6 (preview == seed) in CLAUDE.md composition features: both `saveAgentPrompt` and the `/internal/agents/:id/prompt-preview` endpoint must be updated to pass the same enrichment data to buildAgentClaudeMd — verify both call sites in every prompt-assembly PR.

When a dialog has single vs multi-item phrasing, use a derived boolean flag (e.g. `single = aggregated && count <= 1`) to branch copy only — leave controls, submit logic, and checkbox behaviour untouched; the flag is purely presentational.
